title: On Composing the song in a single night
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：compose　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 compose 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the keeper ① composed the song in a single night before dawn, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② composes the song in a single night in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ compose the song in a single night at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ composed the song in a single night before — a line in the register for March 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Composing the song in a single night before dawn, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ compose three short parts in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Compose three short parts at once and never mention it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ composes three short parts before dawn every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ composed the song in a single night again when nobody else would.

⑩ To compose the song in a single night, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody composes the song in a single night in public again and somebody must compose the song in a single night before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 创作（一般过去式 composed the song in a single night：1952 年饲养员头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 创作（一般现在 composes the song in a single night：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 创作（不定式 to compose the song in a single night：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 创作（过去完成时 had composed the song in a single night：1946 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 创作（动名词 composing the song in a single night 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 构成（compose three short parts：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去构成由三个短小部分组成）
G. v. 构成（compose three short parts：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 创作（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 composes three short parts，而母亲又一次 composed the song in a single night）

answers.why: compose 意为“创作”，1952 年饲养员天没亮就创作一夜工夫写下那支歌，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 composed。
compose 意为“创作”，自那以后饲养员当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 composes。
compose 意为“创作”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯创作一夜工夫写下那支歌”，此处为不定式 to compose the song in a single night。
compose 意为“创作”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1959 年之前就有人创作过，故用过去完成时 had composed。
compose 意为“创作”，饲养员说“创作一夜工夫写下那支歌这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 composing the song in a single night 作主语。
compose 意为“构成”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去构成由三个短小部分组成”，should ever 之后用原形 compose three short parts。
compose 意为“构成”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻构成由三个短小部分组成（compose three short parts at once），以后再也不要提起。
compose 意为“创作”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例构成由三个短小部分组成，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 composes。
compose 意为“创作”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就创作一夜工夫写下那支歌，用一般过去式 composed 叙述。
compose 意为“创作”，结尾那句是母亲 1964 年的话：要创作一夜工夫写下那支歌，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和兽舍记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 compose 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the keeper composed the song in a single night before dawn, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper composes the song in a single night in public whenever the zoo asks.
Composing the song in a single night before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever compose three short parts in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo composes three short parts before dawn every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother composed the song in a single night again, and the zoo remembered that half.
